description: This PHP source file defines a class 'ViewEditFields' that extends 'ViewAjax' and is responsible for rendering an HTML form to edit relationship fields within the SuiteCRM/SugarCRM platform. The class interacts with link definitions to retrieve and display fields associated with a specific relationship.

classes.name: ViewEditFields
classes.description: A class responsible for rendering the HTML form for editing relationship fields in the SuiteCRM platform.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the view by setting relationship parameters, loading the link object, and retrieving the link table definition for fields.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Outputs an HTML form containing input fields for each relationship field, allowing editing of relationship configurations.
